item.title: Awarapan 2 box office collection day 4: Emraan film nears Rs 85 crore
item.summary: Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' has emerged as the standout performer of the Independence Day box office clash, and the sequel to the 2007 cult favourite is now closing in on a major milestone. After a stellar extended weekend, the film enters its first working Monday, typically a day of correction, but with a total that already has trade watchers talking about the Rs. 100 crore mark. Here's a live look at how Day 4 is shaping up.
